title: Ceviche with Yummi Pops Nacho Jalapeño Cream
ingredients: 4 bags of Ranchitas Nacho Excitante (or your preferred flavor)
instructions: Step 1. Place the wings in a bowl, add the spices, and mix until fully combined. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Step 2. After 1 hour, coat the wings with half of the flour.
Step 3. Crush the Ranchitas until they have a texture similar to panko or breadcrumbs and place in a bowl.
Step 4. Beat the eggs with the remaining flour and mix in the crushed Ranchitas until a thick batter forms.
Step 6. Dip the wings into the mixture and fry for 15–20 minutes, or until they reach an internal temperature of 74°C (165°F). Drain on paper towels and serve with ranch sauce or your favorite sauce.
